SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(prc - prc_usd*100) > 1e-6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS real_mismatches,
  MIN(prc*1.0/prc_usd) AS min_ratio, MAX(prc*1.0/prc_usd) AS max_ratio
FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  AVG(prc_usd) AS avg_prc_usd_over_6346,
  COUNT(prc_usd) AS n_usd,
  AVG(prc)/100.0 AS avg_prc_over_6570,
  COUNT(prc) AS n_prc,
  AVG(COALESCE(prc_usd, prc/100.0)) AS avg_coalesced,
  MIN(prc_usd) AS min_usd, MAX(prc_usd) AS max_usd
FROM items_g2

SELECT ref_id, ttl, prc, prc_usd, main_cat FROM items_g2
WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL ORDER BY prc DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT MIN(prc) AS min_prc, MAX(prc) AS max_prc, AVG(prc) AS avg_prc,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc % 100 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mult_of_100,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS under_1000
FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NULL AND prc IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  MAX(prc) AS max_prc_when_usd_present,
  MIN(prc) AS min_prc_when_usd_present,
  COUNT(*) AS n
FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NULL) AS prc_null,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL) AS prc_null_usd_present,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN prc >= 50000 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),4) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL) AS frac_ge_50000,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc >= 50000) AS n_ge_50000;

SELECT main_cat, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_prc, ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0,4) AS avg_usd
FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT main_cat) AS n_cats FROM items_g2;
SELECT ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0, 2) AS avg_price_usd, COUNT(prc) AS n_priced, COUNT(*) AS n_items FROM items_g2;
